description: Minimum water closets and lavatories for each sex in an Ontario office or retail space (Building Code Tables 3.7.4.7 and 3.7.4.8). Preliminary planning figure only. Accessible and universal washroom rules apply separately. The architect, the engineer and the permit set govern.

area_m2.description: Retail only: total area excluding basements. Unit: m2.

male_pct.description: Share counted as male, 0 to 100. The rest are counted as female. Unit: percent.

persons.description: Occupant load (office) or employees at one time (retail). Required. Unit: people.

public.description: Retail only: customers at one time. Unit: people.

type.description: Occupancy: office (Group D, Table 3.7.4.7) or retail (Group E, Table 3.7.4.8).

urinals.description: Use urinals for males up to the Code limit.
